records_request_drafts.draft_body:
Pursuant to the Oklahoma Open Records Act (Okla. Stat. tit. 51 § 24A.1), I request copies of the following public records held by Tulsa Police Department: all contracts, purchase orders, invoices, and service agreements with automated licence-plate-reader (ALPR) vendors (including but not limited to Flock Safety, Motorola/Vigilant, and Genetec), for the period the earliest available date to present.

Please provide responsive records in electronic format where available. If any portion is withheld, please cite the specific statutory exemption for each redaction and release all reasonably segregable non-exempt portions. If you anticipate fees exceeding $25, please contact me with an itemised estimate before proceeding. I would appreciate a response within the Reasonable time (prompt) your law provides.

[Filing is a public act attributable to the filer; the acknowledgement is completed at filing time (SIG-TASK-018).]

Submitted by: [the contributor who files this request — completed at filing time]. Records contact: (records contact to be determined at filing time).
